tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind cards and lists.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, navigation rail and bottom bar.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells, table headers, the neutral badge background.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines between rows and around cards. Not for controls.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, checkboxes and secondary buttons. 3:1 on surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, authorship, timestamps. 7:1 on surface.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: THE BRAND COLOUR. Primary buttons, links, the selected navigation item, focus rings. Change this first when rebranding.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected navigation background and informational badge background. Text on it is accent.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Conformity findings and received evidence. Text on ok-soft or surface.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Background of conformity badges.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Minor non-conformity, partial or promised evidence. Text on warn-soft or surface.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Background of warning badges.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Major non-conformity, missing high-criticality evidence, destructive actions. Text on danger-soft or surface.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of danger badges.

tokens.name: ai
tokens.usage: Anything written by AI and not yet accepted by a person. Text on ai-soft or surface; also the dashed proposal border.

tokens.name: ai-soft
tokens.usage: Background of AI proposal badges and proposal cards.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen title on phone, sheet title.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: All running text and form values.
styles.sample: Access rights are reviewed every six months.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: v4 · Claude on behalf of Juris · 12 Nov 14:02

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Badge text and field labels. Sentence case, never all caps.

styles.name: ref
styles.usage: Requirement reference codes, version numbers, hashes.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label inside a badge.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between badges, between rows of metadata.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of list rows and navigation items.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, screen side margin on phone.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards, screen side margin on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between screen sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, criticality bars, small tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, navigation items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and sheets.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Badges and progress bars.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Sheets and menus that float above the page. Cards use a border, not a shadow.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height of anything tappable on a phone.

tokens.name: nav-rail
tokens.usage: Width of the desktop navigation rail.

tokens.name: bottom-bar
tokens.usage: Height of the phone bottom navigation bar.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the content column on desktop.

tokens.name: sheet-width
tokens.usage: Width of the item sheet on desktop. On a phone the sheet is full screen.
